sources.snippet: IntellIte Chat IntellIte Chat is a lightweight conversational AI model (~45M parameters) designed for warm, engaging dialogue and basic reasoning. Part of the IntellIte series, it delivers efficient performance on modest hardware, complete with streaming data loading, episodic memory buffers, and RAG-based knowledge augmentation.
